summary: The scream has a name now: the Coordinate. Ragako explains the missing hole. The season ends with the enemy outside, and the secret still inside the walls.

segments.ja: ウォール・ローゼの門の内側で、季節の最後の夜が始まります。始まる夜に、歓声はありません。ない代わりに、報告の束があります。束の中心は、エレンの叫びです。叫びは、悲しみの音であると同時に、巨人の向きを変えた力です。力に、座標という名が仮に付きます。仮の名を、エルヴィンは戦力の欄に置き、ミカサはハンネスの死の隣に置きます。置く場所が違うことが、この夜の分裂です。
segments.en: Inside the gate of Wall Rose, the last night of the season begins. In the night that begins, there is no cheering. In place of what is not there, there is a bundle of reports. The center of the bundle is Eren's scream. The scream is the sound of grief and, at the same time, the power that turned the Titans. The name Coordinate is attached to the power, provisionally. Erwin sets the provisional name in the column of fighting power, and Mikasa sets it beside Hannes's death. The difference of where they set it is the split of this night.

segments.ja: ハンジは、負傷の包帯の上で結論を短くします。短くした結論は、ラガコ村の人々が巨人にされた、だから穴が無かった、です。です、という文が、コニーの母の顔を仮説から対象へ移します。移した対象を、彼女は残酷さのために大きくは言いません。言わない代わりに、ノートの一行に残します。残した一行が、壁の中の巨人と、外の戦士を同じ技術の家族にします。家族という言葉は、ここでは血ではなく、方法です。
segments.en: On top of the bandages of her injury, Hange shortens the conclusion. The shortened conclusion is that the people of Ragako Village were made into Titans, and that is why there was no hole. The sentence moves the face of Connie's mother from hypothesis to subject. She does not say the moved subject loudly for the sake of cruelty. Instead of saying it, she leaves it as one line in the notes. The line she leaves makes the Titans inside the walls and the warriors outside into a family of the same technique. The word family, here, is not blood. It is method.

segments.ja: コニーは、その一行を人より先に受け取ります。受け取る場所は、会議の席ではなく、夜の通路です。通路で、彼はただいまの返事が無かった家を、もう一度見ます。見る家は、もう村にはありません。ない家の代わりに、仮説の中の母がいます。いる母を、彼は死亡としてはまだ書けません。書けないまま、サシャが隣に座ります。座ることは、説明ではなく、同じ故郷を失った者の距離です。
segments.en: Connie receives that one line ahead of the others. The place of receiving is not a seat at the meeting. It is a passage at night. In the passage he looks once more at the house that had no answer to coming home. The house he looks at is no longer in the village. In place of the house that is not there, there is a mother inside the hypothesis. He still cannot write that mother as a death. Unable to write it, Sasha sits beside him. Sitting is not an explanation. It is the distance of people who lost the same kind of hometown.

segments.ja: エルヴィンは、座標を次の壁外の鍵として見ます。見る鍵は、エレンの意思が巨人を動かす、という観測です。観測は、再現の実験を要求します。要求を、エレンは今夜は拒みます。拒む理由は、ハンネスの死がスイッチの記憶と繋がっているからです。繋がった記憶を、団長は無視しません。無視しないうえで、なお鍵は必要だと言います。言う必要と、拒む人間性が、同じ部屋に残ります。
segments.en: Erwin sees the Coordinate as a key for the next time beyond the walls. The key he sees is the observation that Eren's will moves Titans. The observation demands an experiment of reproduction. Eren refuses the demand tonight. The reason he refuses is that Hannes's death is connected to the memory of the switch. The Commander does not ignore the connected memory. Not ignoring it, he still says the key is necessary. The necessity he states and the humanity that refuses remain in the same room.

segments.en: Mikasa does not hand Eren over as a specimen of the Coordinate. The boundary of not handing him over is not a declaration of rebellion against the Survey Corps. It is not a declaration. It is the condition under which he breathes while remaining a person. Levi understands the condition and continues the watch. The watch he continues is not a restart of chains. It is not a restart. It is a distance so that the scream does not wrap a city once more. Inside the distance, Eren drinks water and sees his mother's face and Hannes's face at the same time. The face that sees them is not a victor's face.

segments.en: The Beast Titan is not in the room of this night. The opponent who is not there still leaves the fact that it threw, spoke, and broke Mike's squad. segments.en: Nick's silence has not been untied even though the season is ending. The untied silence and the one line about Ragako sit next to each other on the same shelf. By sitting next to each other, it becomes clear that the wall is a structure that protects and, at the same time, a structure that hides. The royal government still does not make what has become clear public. The Survey Corps no longer shares the public silence that does not make it so. Not sharing it is the seed of the next conflict. The seed has not sprouted yet today. Even without sprouting, the soil is cracked.

segments.ja: エレンは、この夜には叫びません。叫ばないことが、座標を消したことにはなりません。ならない力を、彼は喉の奥に感じたまま横になります。横になった隣で、ミカサは起きています。起きていることが、試料にしないという境界の実行です。実行は、派手ではありません。派手でない境界が、彼を人の寝息へ戻します。戻った寝息は、勝利の音楽ではありません。音楽ではなく、まだ生きているという音です。
segments.en: Eren does not scream on this night. Not screaming does not mean he has erased the Coordinate. He lies down still feeling, deep in the throat, the power that has not been erased. Beside where he lies, Mikasa is awake. Being awake is the carrying-out of the boundary of not making him a specimen. The carrying-out is not showy. The boundary that is not showy returns him to a human's sleeping breath. The sleeping breath that returned is not the music of victory. It is not music. It is the sound of still being alive.
